title: Ghostly Cat’s Head Nebula lurks within sight of Hubble and Webb
caption:
The Cat’s Head Nebula is a temporary star-forming region located 7500 light-years away. By combining Hubble and Webb imagery, we can finally see what’s hidden inside this dusty feline structure.

Source: Esa - Ghostly Cat’s Head Nebula lurks within sight of Hubble and Webb
